com.git-pull.libtmux-mcp/capability.description: Runs one authored command in a trusted pane shell and waits for singular framed output and completion. Its two preflights refuse caller or attended panes and an effective cohort larger than one. Pre-existing exact-client-path, trap, eval, or exit functions are outside the supported boundary; marker display-message commands honor the trusted server's command aliases and hooks. Run a shell command in a pane with your user's permissions.

com.git-pull.libtmux-mcp/capability.description: Sends input to the target's configured effective synchronized cohort without waiting for output. Every configured member must be live, nonmodal, and neither caller nor attended. Reports configured pane ids observed before dispatch, not delivery receipts. wait_for_text discounts recognized input; wait for the prompt before typing into a cold shell. Send input to a pane's program; a shell that receives it runs it with your user's permissions.

enter.description: Press Enter afterward, as a real keypress. Unlike a key named "Enter" sent under literal:true, which types the four letters, this always submits. Defaults to false.

keys.description: The key names or literal strings to send. One value may be sent on its own, without a list.

literal.description: Send strings literally instead of as key names. Defaults to false.
